intended_behavior: Refactor to replace untyped "callback" dict event yields with strongly-typed event objects dispatched through the new general-purpose hook system. Support multiple composable subscribers, selective event invocation, and typed arguments, while preserving the existing event loop lifecycle and error handling.

Initialize and integrate the new hook system replacing the old callback_handler mechanism. Update these methods to invoke hooks selectively on event occurrence, respect composability and ordering, ensure backward compatibility of default behaviors, and leverage typed events from the new system.
